helpWaiting.title: About waiting chats
helpWaiting.overview: Visitors of your website who asked to talk to a person. A conversation waits here until someone on your team takes it.

sections.title: Answer visitors
items: Peek to read a conversation without joining it.
Join to answer it: it moves to Mine.
Hand it back to the assistant bot, or close it when it's done.

sections.title: Assistant bot
items: The bot answers visitors first. Its greeting, whether visitors must say who they are, and whether they can ask for a person are set on your Company page.

helpMine.title: About Mine
helpMine.overview: Mine contains public website conversations that you have joined. Waiting is the queue of conversations you have not taken.

sections.title: Work your conversations
items: Continue the visitor thread from this list.
Release the conversation to the bot when human handling is no longer needed, or close it when finished.
